verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፤ በሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይግብኡ ፡ ወይኅድሩ ፡ አንጻረ ፡ ኢጴውሎስ ፡ ማእከለ
                  ፡ መግዱሎ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ መንገለ ፡ [ብ]ዕልሴፎን ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ኀደሩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Atunci a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez: ወይብል ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ በእንተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሳኰዩ ፡ እ[ሙ]ንቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ አርከበቶሙ ፡ ሐቅል ።
verses.translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and let them turn and encamp before the village, between Magdol and the sea, opposite Beel-sepphon: before them shalt thou encamp by the sea.

translations.lxx: Speak to the children of Israel, and let them turn and encamp before the village, between Magdol and the sea, opposite Beel-sepphon: before them shalt thou encamp by the sea.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
translations.ron: "Spune fiilor lui Israel să se întoarcă şi să-şi aşeze tabăra în faţa Pi-Hahirotului, între Migdal şi mare, în preajma lui Baal-Ţefon. Acolo, în preajma lui, lângă mare, să tăbărâţi.
translations.grk: Λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀποστρέψαντες στρατοπεδευσάτωσαν ἀπέναντι τῆς ἐπαύλεως, ἀνὰ μέσον Μαγδώλου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς θαλάσσης, ἐξεναντίας Βεελσεπφῶν· ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν στρατοπεδεύσεις ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης.

verses.geez:
ወአነ ፡ አጸንዕ ፡ ልቦ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወይዴግኖሙ ፡ እምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወእሴባሕ ፡ አነ ፡ በፈርዖን ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ሐራሁ ፡
                  ወይእምሩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ከመ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፤
verses.translation: And Pharao will say to his people, As for these children of Israel, they are wandering in the land, for the wilderness has shut them in.

translations.lxx: And Pharao will say to his people, As for these children of Israel, they are wandering in the land, for the wilderness has shut them in.
translations.kjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
translations.ron: Că Faraon va zice către poporul său: Fiii aceştia ai lui Israel s-au rătăcit în pământul acesta şi i-a închis pustiul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐρεῖ Φαραὼ τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ, οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ πλανῶνται οὗτοι ἐν τῇ γῇ, συγκέκλεικε γὰρ αὐτοὺς ἡ ἔρημος.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ከማሁ ።
verses.translation: And I will harden the heart of Pharao, and he shall pursue after them; and I will be glorified in Pharao, and in all his host, and all the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord. And they did so.

translations.lxx: And I will harden the heart of Pharao, and he shall pursue after them; and I will be glorified in Pharao, and in all his host, and all the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord. And they did so.
translations.kjv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD. And they did so.
translations.ron: Iar Eu voi învârtoşa inima lui Faraon şi va alerga după ei. Şi-Mi voi arăta slava Mea asupra lui Faraon şi asupra a toată oştirea lui; şi vor cunoaşte toţi Egiptenii că Eu sunt Domnul!" Şi au făcut aşa.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ σκληρυνῶ τὴν καρδίαν Φαραὼ, καὶ καταδιώξεται ὀπίσω αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐνδοξασθήσομαι ἐν Φαραῷ, καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ στρατίᾳ αὐτοῦ· καὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος· καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως.

verses.geez:
ወዜነውዎ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ከመ ፡ ነፍጸ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወተመይጠ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወዘዐበይቱ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡
                  ወይቤ ፡ ምንትኑዝ ፡ ዘገበርነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንፈንዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትቀነዩ ፡ ለነ ።
verses.translation: And it was reported to the king of the Egyptians that the people had fled: and the heart of Pharao was turned, and that of his servants against the people; and they said, What is this that we have done, to let the children of Israel go, so that they should not serve us?

translations.lxx: And it was reported to the king of the Egyptians that the people had fled: and the heart of Pharao was turned, and that of his servants against the people; and they said, What is this that we have done, to let the children of Israel go, so that they should not serve us?
translations.kjv: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
translations.ron: Atunci s-a dat de ştire regelui Egiptului că poporul evreu a fugit. şi s-a întors inima lui Faraon şi a slujitorilor lui asupra poporului acestuia şi ei au zis: "Ce am făcut noi? Cum de am lăsat pe fiii lui Israel să se ducă şi să nu ne mai robească nouă?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τῷ βασιλεῖ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ὅτι πέφευγεν ὁ λαός· καὶ μετεστράφη ἡ καρδία Φαραὼ, καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ, ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν, καὶ εἶπαν, τί τοῦτο ἐποιήσαμεν, τοῦ ἐξαποστεῖλαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ, τοῦ μὴ δουλεύειν ἡμῖν;

verses.geez: ወአንሥአ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሰረገላቲሁ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ሕዝቦ ፡ አስተጋብአ ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.translation: So Pharao yoked his chariots, and led off all his people with himself:

translations.lxx: So Pharao yoked his chariots, and led off all his people with himself:
translations.kjv: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
translations.ron: A înhămat deci Faraon carele sale de război şi a luat poporul său cu sine:
translations.grk: Ἔζευξεν οὖν Φαραὼ τὰ ἅρματα αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ συναπήγαγε μεθʼ ἑαυτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ፯፻ሰረገላ ፡ ኅሩየ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ አፍራሶሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ወሠለሶሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ።
verses.translation: having also taken six hundred chosen chariots, and all the cavalry of the Egyptians, and rulers over all.

translations.lxx: having also taken six hundred chosen chariots, and all the cavalry of the Egyptians, and rulers over all.
translations.kjv: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
translations.ron: A luat cu sine şase sute de căruţe alese şi toată călărimea Egiptului şi căpeteniile lor.
translations.grk: καὶ λαβὼν ἑξακόσια ἅρματα ἐκλεκτὰ, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἵππον τῶν Αἰγυπτίων, καὶ τριστάτας ἐπὶ πάντων.

verses.geez:
ወአጽንዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ልቦ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወዴገነ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወደቂቀ
                  ፡ እስራኤልሰ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ በእድ ፡ ልዕልት ።
verses.translation: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharao king of Egypt, and of his servants, and he pursued after the children of Israel; and the children of Israel went forth with a high hand.

translations.lxx: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharao king of Egypt, and of his servants, and he pursued after the children of Israel; and the children of Israel went forth with a high hand.
translations.kjv: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
translations.ron: Iar Domnul a învârtoşat inima lui Faraon, regele Egiptului, şi a slujitorilor lui, şi a alergat acesta după fiii lui Israel; dar fiii lui Israel ieşiseră sub mână înaltă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐσκλήρυνε Κύριος τὴν καρδίαν Φαραὼ βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου, καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ, καὶ κατεδίωξεν ὀπίσω τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἐξεπορεύοντο ἐν χειρὶ ὑψηλῇ.

verses.geez:
ወዴገንዎሙ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወረከብዎሙ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ተዓየኑ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ፈረስ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡
                  ሰረገላ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወሐራሁ ፡ አንጻረ ፡ እጰውሊዮስ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ብዕለ ፡ ሴፎን ።
verses.translation: And the Egyptians pursued after them, and found them encamped by the sea; and all the cavalry and the chariots of Pharao, and the horsemen, and his host were before the village, over against Beel-sepphon.

translations.lxx: And the Egyptians pursued after them, and found them encamped by the sea; and all the cavalry and the chariots of Pharao, and the horsemen, and his host were before the village, over against Beel-sepphon.
translations.kjv: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
translations.ron: Şi au alergat după ei Egiptenii cu toii caii şi carele lui Faraon, cu călăreţii şi cu toată oştirea lui şi i-au ajuns când poposiseră ei la mare, lângă Pi-Hahirot, în faţa lui Baal-Ţefon.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατεδίωξαν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὀπίσω αὐτῶν, καὶ εὕροσαν αὐτοὺς παρεμβεβληκότας παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν· καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἵππος καὶ τὰ ἅρματα Φαραὼ, καὶ οἱ ἱππεῖς, καὶ ἡ στρατιὰ αὐτοῦ ἀπέναντι τῆς ἐπαύλεως, ἐξεναντίας Βεελσεπφῶν.

verses.geez:
ወተንሥአ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወነጸሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወርእይዎሙ ፡ ወይግዕዙ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወፈርሁ ፡ ጥቀ ፡
                  ወአውየዉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Pharao approached, and the children of Israel having looked up, beheld, and the Egyptians encamped behind them: and they were very greatly terrified, and the children of Israel cried to the Lord;

translations.lxx: And Pharao approached, and the children of Israel having looked up, beheld, and the Egyptians encamped behind them: and they were very greatly terrified, and the children of Israel cried to the Lord;
translations.kjv: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Dar când s-a apropiat Faraon şi când s-au uitat fiii lui Israel înapoi şi au văzut că Egiptenii vin după ei, s-au spăimântat foarte tare fiii lui Israel şi au strigat către Domnul;
translations.grk: Καὶ Φαραὼ προσῆγε· καὶ ἀναβλέψαντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ὁρῶσι, καὶ οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἐστρατοπέδευσαν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα· ἀνεβόησαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Κύριον.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዝ[ኅ]ርነሂ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢየሀሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ አውጻእከነ ፡ ትቅትለነ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  በድው ፡ ወምንትኑዝ ፡ ዘገበርከ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ዘአውጻእከነ ፡ እምብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: and said to Moses, Because there were no graves in the land of Egypt, hast thou brought us forth to slay us in the wilderness? What is this that thou hast done to us, having brought us out of Egypt?

translations.lxx: and said to Moses, Because there were no graves in the land of Egypt, hast thou brought us forth to slay us in the wilderness? What is this that thou hast done to us, having brought us out of Egypt?
translations.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
translations.ron: Şi au zis către Moise: "Oare nu erau morminte în ţara Egiptului, de ce ne-ai adus să murim în pustie? Ce ai făcut tu cu noi, scoţându-ne din Egipt?
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Μωυσῆν, παρὰ τὸ μὴ ὑπάρχειν μνήματα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ, ἐξήγαγες ἡμᾶς θανατῶσαι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· τί τοῦτο ἐποίησας ἡμῖν, ἐξαγαγὼν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου;

verses.geez:
አኮሁ ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ቃልነ ፡ ዘንቤለከ ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ኅድገነ ፡ ንትቀነይ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይኄይሰነ ፡
                  ተቀንዮተ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ እመዊት ፡ በበድው ።
verses.translation: Is not this the word which we spoke to thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone that we may serve the Egyptians? for it is better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in this wilderness.

translations.lxx: Is not this the word which we spoke to thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone that we may serve the Egyptians? for it is better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in this wilderness.
translations.kjv: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
translations.ron: Nu ţi-am spus noi, oare, de aceasta în Egipt, când ţi-am zis: Lasă-ne să robim Egiptenilor, că e mai bine să fim robi Egiptenilor decât să murim în pustia aceasta?"
translations.grk: Οὐ τοῦτο ἦν τὸ ῥῆμα, ὃ ἐλαλήσαμεν πρὸς σὲ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ, λέγοντες, πάρες ἡμᾶς, ὅπως δουλεύσωμεν τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις; κρεῖσσον γὰρ ἡμᾶς δουλεύειν τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις, ἢ ἀποθανεῖν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ተአመኑ ፡ ወቁሙ ፡ ወትርአዩ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እንተ ፡ ይገብር ፡
                  ለነ ፡ ዮም ፡ እስመ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሬእይዎሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ዳግመ ፡ ኢትሬእይዎሙ ፡ እንከ ፡ ጕንዱየ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to the people, Be of good courage: stand and see the salvation which is from the Lord, which he will work for us this day; for as ye have seen the Egyptians to-day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to the people, Be of good courage: stand and see the salvation which is from the Lord, which he will work for us this day; for as ye have seen the Egyptians to-day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
translations.ron: Moise însă a zis către popor: "Nu vă temeţi! Staţi şi veţi vedea minunea cea de la Domnul, pe care vă va face-o El astăzi, căci pe Egiptenii pe care îi vedeţi astăzi nu-i veţi mai vedea niciodată.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν, θαρσεῖτε, στῆτε καὶ ὁρᾶτε τὴν σωτηρίαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ Κυρίου, ἣν ποιήσει ἡμῖν σήμερον· ὃν τρόπον γὰρ ἑωράκατε τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους σήμερον, οὐ προσθήσεσθε ἔτι ἰδεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον·

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይፀብእ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ወአንትሙሰ ፡ አርምሙ ።
verses.translation: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

translations.lxx: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
translations.ron: Domnul are să Se lupte pentru voi, iar voi fiţi liniştiţi!"
translations.grk: Κύριος πολεμήσει περὶ ὑμῶν, καὶ ὑμεῖς σιγήσετε.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ትጸርሕ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ በሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ይንድኡ ፡ እንስሳሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Why criest thou to me? speak to the children of Israel, and let them proceed.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Why criest thou to me? speak to the children of Israel, and let them proceed.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul către Moise: "Ce strigi către Mine? Spune fiilor lui Israel să pornească,
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, τί βοᾷς πρός με; λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀναζευξάτωσαν.

verses.geez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ ንሣእ ፡ በትረከ ፡ ወስፋሕ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወዝብጣ ፡ ወይባኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ማእከለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ የብስ ።
verses.translation: And do thou lift up thy rod, and stretch forth thy hand over the sea, and divide it, and let the children of Israel enter into the midst of the sea on the dry land.

translations.lxx: And do thou lift up thy rod, and stretch forth thy hand over the sea, and divide it, and let the children of Israel enter into the midst of the sea on the dry land.
translations.kjv: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
translations.ron: Iar tu ridică-n toiagul şi-ţi întinde mâna asupra mării şi o desparte şi vor trece fiii lui Israel prin mijlocul mării, ca pe uscat.
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ ἔπαρον τῇ ῥάβδῳ σου, καὶ ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ῥῆξον αὐτήν· καὶ εἰσελθάτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς μέσον τῆς θαλάσσης κατὰ τὸ ξηρόν.

verses.geez:
ወናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ አጸንዕ ፡ ልቦ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወይበውኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወእሴባሕ ፡ አነ ፡ በፈርዖን
                  ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ሐራሁ ፡ ወበሰረገላቲሁ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ አፍራሲሁ ።
verses.translation: And lo! I will harden the heart of Pharao and of all the Egyptians, and they shall go in after them; and I will be glorified upon Pharao, and on all his host, and on his chariots and his horses.

translations.lxx: And lo! I will harden the heart of Pharao and of all the Egyptians, and they shall go in after them; and I will be glorified upon Pharao, and on all his host, and on his chariots and his horses.
translations.kjv: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
translations.ron: Iată, Eu voi învârtoşa inima lui Faraon şi a tuturor Egiptenilor, ca să meargă pe urmele lor. Şi-Mi voi arăta slava Mea asupra lui Faraon şi asupra a toată oştirea lui, asupra carelor lui şi asupra călăreţilor lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ σκληρυνῶ τὴν καρδίαν Φαραὼ, καὶ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων πάντων, καὶ εἰσελεύσονται ὀπίσω αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐνδοξασθήσομαι ἐν Φαραῷ, καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ στρατιᾷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἅρμασι, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἵπποις αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወያእምሩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ከመ ፡ አነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተሰቢሕየ ፡ በፈርዖን ፡ ወበሰረገላሁ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ አፍራሲሁ ።
verses.translation: And all the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I am glorified upon Pharao and upon his chariots and his horses.

translations.lxx: And all the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I am glorified upon Pharao and upon his chariots and his horses.
translations.kjv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
translations.ron: Şi vor cunoaşte toţi Egiptenii că Eu sunt Domnul, când Îmi voi arăta slava Mea asupra lui Faraon, asupra carelor lui şi asupra călăreţilor lui".
translations.grk: Καὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμὶ Κύριος, ἐνδοξαζομένου μου ἐν Φαραῷ, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἅρμασι, καὶ ἵπποις αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወሰሰለ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘየሐውር ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወቆመ ፡ እምድኅሬሆሙ ፡
                  ወሰሰለ ፡ ዐምደ ፡ ደመና ፡ እምቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ወቆመ ፡ እምድኅሬሆም ።
verses.translation: And the angel of God that went before the camp of the children of Israel removed and went behind, and the pillar of the cloud also removed from before them and stood behind them.

translations.lxx: And the angel of God that went before the camp of the children of Israel removed and went behind, and the pillar of the cloud also removed from before them and stood behind them.
translations.kjv: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
translations.ron: Atunci s-a ridicat îngerul Domnului, care mergea înaintea taberei fiilor lui Israel, şi s-a mutat în urma lor; şi s-a ridicat stâlpul cel de nor dinaintea lor şi a stat în urma lor.
translations.grk: Ἐξῇρε δὲ ὁ Ἄγγελος τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ προπορευόμενος τῆς παρεμβολῆς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν· ἐξῇρε δὲ καὶ ὁ στύλος τὴς νεφέλης ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔστη ἐκ τῶν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወቦአ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ቆባር ፡ ወጽልመት ፡
                  ወኢተደመሩ ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ ፡ ኵለንታሃ ፡ ሌሊተ ።
verses.translation: And it went between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel, and stood; and there was darkness and blackness; and the night passed, and they came not near to one another during the whole night.

translations.lxx: And it went between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel, and stood; and there was darkness and blackness; and the night passed, and they came not near to one another during the whole night.
translations.kjv: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
translations.ron: Astfel a trecut el şi a stat între tabăra Egiptenilor şi tabăra fiilor lui Israel; şi era negură şi întuneric pentru unii, iar pentru ceilalţi lumină, noaptea, şi toată noaptea nu s-au apropiat unii de alţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων, καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς τῶν Αἰγυπίων, καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἔστη· καὶ ἐγένετο σκότος καὶ γνόφος· καὶ διῆλθεν ἡ νύξ· καὶ οὐ συνέμιξαν ἀλλήλοις ὅλην τὴν νύκτα.

verses.geez:
ወሰፍሐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወአምጽአ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ነፋሰ ፡ አዜብ ፡ (ላዕለ ፡ ባሕር ፡) ጽኑዐ
                  ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ወገብራ ፡ ለባሕር ፡ የብሰ ፡ ወሠጠጦ ፡ ለማይ ።
verses.translation: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the Lord carried back the sea with a strong south wind all the night, and made the sea dry, and the water was divided.

translations.lxx: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the Lord carried back the sea with a strong south wind all the night, and made the sea dry, and the water was divided.
translations.kjv: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
translations.ron: Iar Moise şi-a întins mâna sa asupra mării şi a alungat Domnul marea toată noaptea cu vânt puternic de la răsărit şi s-a făcut marea uscat, că s-au despărţit apele.
translations.grk: Ἐξέτεινε δὲ Μωυσῆς τὴν χεῖρα ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν· καὶ ὑπήγαγε Κύριος τὴν θάλασσαν ἐν ἀνέμῳ νότῳ βιαίῳ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα, καὶ ἐποίησε τὴν θάλασσαν ξηράν· καὶ ἐσχίσθη τὸ ὕδωρ.

verses.geez:
ወቦኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ የብስ ፡ ወማይሰ ፡ ኮነ ፡ አረፍተ ፡ በየማኖሙ ፡ ወአረፍተ ፡
                  በፀጋሞሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry land, and the water of it was a wall on the right hand and a wall on the left.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry land, and the water of it was a wall on the right hand and a wall on the left.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
translations.ron: Şi au intrat fiii lui Israel prin mijlocul mării, mergând ca pe uscat, iar apele le erau perete, la dreapta şi la stânga lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς μέσον τῆς θαλάσσης κατὰ τὸ ξηρόν· καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ αὐτῆς τεῖχος ἐκ δεξιῶν, καὶ τεῖχος ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

verses.geez:
ወዴገንዎሙ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወቦኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ አፍራሰ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወሰረገላቲሁ ፡ ወመስተጽዕናን ፡ ቦኡ ፡ ማእከለ
                  ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.translation: And the Egyptians pursued them and went in after them, and every horse of Pharao, and his chariots, and his horsemen, into the midst of the sea.

translations.lxx: And the Egyptians pursued them and went in after them, and every horse of Pharao, and his chariots, and his horsemen, into the midst of the sea.
translations.kjv: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
translations.ron: Iar Egiptenii urmărindu-i, au intrat după ei în mijlocul mării toii caii lui Faraon, carele şi călăreţii lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ κάτεδίωξαν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι, καὶ εἰσῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶς ἵππος Φαραὼ, καὶ τὰ ἅρματα, καὶ οἱ ἀναβάται, εἰς μέσον τῆς θαλάσσης.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ዕቅበተ ፡ ሌሊት ፡ እንተ ፡ አፈ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ወነጸረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡
                  በዐምደ ፡ እሳት ፡ ወደመና ፡ ወአዘዘ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning watch that the Lord looked forth on the camp of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and cloud, and troubled the camp of the Egyptians,

translations.lxx: And it came to pass in the morning watch that the Lord looked forth on the camp of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and cloud, and troubled the camp of the Egyptians,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
translations.ron: Dar în straja dimineţii a căutat Domnul din stâlpul cel de foc şi din nor spre tabăra Egiptenilor şi a umplut tabăra Egiptenilor de spaimă.
translations.grk: Ἐγενήθη δὲ ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ τῇ ἑωθινῇ, καὶ ἐπίβλεψε Κύριος ἐπὶ τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἐν στύλῳ πυρὸς καὶ νεφέλης, καὶ συνετάραξε τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων,

verses.geez:
ወአሰረ ፡ ማእሰርተ ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ ፡ ወወሰዶሙ ፡ በሥቃይ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ንንፈጽ ፡ እምገጾሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡
                  እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይፅብዕ ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: and bound the axle-trees of their chariots, and caused them to go with difficulty; and the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians.

translations.lxx: and bound the axle-trees of their chariots, and caused them to go with difficulty; and the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians.
translations.kjv: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
translations.ron: Şi a făcut să sară roţile de la carele lor, încât cu anevoie mergeau carele. Atunci au zis Egiptenii: "Să fugim de la faţa lui Israel, că Domnul se luptă pentru ei cu Egiptenii!"
translations.grk: καὶ συνέδησε τοὺς ἄξονας τῶν ἁρμάτων αὐτῶν, καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς μετὰ βίας· καὶ εἶπαν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι, φυγωμεν ἀπὸ προσώπου Ἰσραήλ· ὁ γὰρ Κύριος πολεμεῖ περὶ αὐτῶν τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ስፋሕ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወይትገባእ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወዲበ ፡
                  ሰረገላቲሁ ፡ ወዲበ ፡ መስተጽዕናኒሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Stretch forth thine hand over the sea, and let the water be turned back to its place, and let it cover the Egyptians coming both upon the chariots and the riders.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Stretch forth thine hand over the sea, and let the water be turned back to its place, and let it cover the Egyptians coming both upon the chariots and the riders.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
translations.ron: Iar Domnul a zis către Moise: "Întindeţi mâna asupra mării, ca să se întoarcă apele asupra Egiptenilor, asupra carelor lor şi asupra călăreţilor lor".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἀποκαταστήτω τὸ ὕδωρ, καὶ ἐπικαλυψάτω τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους, ἐπί τε τὰ ἅρματα καὶ τοὺς ἀναβάτας.

verses.geez:
ወሰፍሐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወከደኖሙ ፡ ባሕር ፡ በዕለቱ ፡ ወዐገቶሙ ፡ እምድኅር ፡ ወጐዩ ፡ ግብጽ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወነገፎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.translation: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the water returned to its place toward day; and the Egyptians fled from the water, and the Lord shook off the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

translations.lxx: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the water returned to its place toward day; and the Egyptians fled from the water, and the Lord shook off the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
translations.kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
translations.ron: Şi şi-a întins Moise mâna asupra mării şi spre ziuă s-a întors apa la locul ei, iar Egiptenii fugeau împotriva apei. Şi aşa a înecat Dumnezeu pe Egipteni în mijlocul mării.
translations.grk: Ἐξέτεινε δὲ Μωυσῆς τὴν χεῖρα ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἀπεκατέστη τὸ ὕδωρ πρὸς ἡμέραν ἐπὶ χώρας· οἱ δὲ Αἰγύπτιοι ἔφυγον ὑπὸ τὸ ὕδωρ· καὶ ἐξετίναξε Κύριος τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους μέσον τῆς θαλάσοης.

verses.geez:
ወተመይጠ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወተሰጥሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ ፡ ወ[መስተጽዕና]ኒሆሙ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ በከመ ፡
                  መጽኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘተርፈ ፡ እምእለ ፡ መጽኡ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ወኢአሐዱ ።
verses.translation: And the water returned and covered the chariots and the riders, and all the forces of Pharao, who entered after them into the sea: and there was not left of them even one.

translations.lxx: And the water returned and covered the chariots and the riders, and all the forces of Pharao, who entered after them into the sea: and there was not left of them even one.
translations.kjv: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
translations.ron: Iar apele s-au tras la loc şi au acoperit carele şi călăreţii întregii oştiri a lui Faraon, care intrase după Israeliţi în mare, şi nu a rămas nici unul dintre ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπαναστραφὲν τὸ ὕδωρ ἐκάλυψε τὰ ἅρματα καὶ τοὺς ἀναβάτας, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν Φαραὼ, τοὺς εἰσπεπορευμένους ὀπίσω αὐτῶν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν· καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς.

verses.geez: ወውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሖሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይብስት ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወባሕር ፡ አረፍተ ፡ ኮኖሙ ፡ እምይምን ፡ ወእምፅግም ።
verses.translation: But the children of Israel went along dry land in the midst of the sea, and the water was to them a wall on the right hand, and a wall on the left.

translations.lxx: But the children of Israel went along dry land in the midst of the sea, and the water was to them a wall on the right hand, and a wall on the left.
translations.kjv: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Israel însă au trecut prin mare ca pe uscat şi apa le-a fost perete la dreapta şi stânga lor.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπορεύθησαν διὰ ξηρᾶς ἐν μέσῳ τῆς θάλασσης· τὸ δὲ ὕδωρ αὐτοῖς τεῖχος ἐκ δεξιῶν, καὶ τεῖχος ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

verses.geez:
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ወርእዩ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ሞቱ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ድንጋጉ ፡ ለባሕር ።
verses.translation: So the Lord delivered Israel in that day from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead by the shore of the sea.

translations.lxx: So the Lord delivered Israel in that day from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead by the shore of the sea.
translations.kjv: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
translations.ron: Aşa a izbăvit Domnul în ziua aceea pe Israeliţi din mâinile Egiptenilor; şi au văzut fiii lui Israel pe Egipteni morţi pe malurile mării.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐῤῥύσατο Κύριος τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων· καὶ εἶδεν Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους τεθνηκότας παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እደ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ወፈርሀ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአምኑ ፡
                  በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሙሴሃኒ ፡ አዕበዩ ፡ ላእኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Israel saw the mighty hand, the things which the Lord did to the Egyptians; and the people feared the Lord, and they believed God and Moses his servant.

translations.lxx: And Israel saw the mighty hand, the things which the Lord did to the Egyptians; and the people feared the Lord, and they believed God and Moses his servant.
translations.kjv: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.
translations.ron: Văzut-a Israel mâna cea tare pe care a întins-o Domnul asupra Egiptenilor, şi s-a temut poporul de Domnul şi a crezut în Domnul şi în Moise, sluga Lui.
translations.grk: Εἶδε δὲ Ἰσραὴλ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν μεγάλην, ἃ ἐποίησε Κύριος τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις· ἐφοβήθη δὲ ὁ λαὸς τὸν Κύριον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῷ Θεῷ, καὶ Μωυσῇ τῷ θεράποντι αὐτοῦ.
